seo.description: Old Stone Presbyterian Church in Larkfield, NJ. Traditional worship with choir and organ every Sunday at 10:00 AM. All are welcome.

contact.officeHours: Tuesday to Thursday, 9 AM to 1 PM

specialServices.title: Christmas Eve Lessons & Carols
specialServices.note: The 11 PM service closes with candlelight and Silent Night.

hero.headline: A place of worship, rooted in history and open to all
hero.subhead: Traditional worship, beautiful music and a warm congregation in the heart of Larkfield.

welcome.heading: Welcome to Old Stone
paragraphs: For more than two centuries, people have gathered in our sanctuary to worship God, hear Scripture and care for one another. Whether you grew up Presbyterian or have never been to church, you will find a seat and a friendly face here.
Join us for hymns sung with our choir and pipe organ, a thoughtful sermon and coffee hour afterward.

story: Old Stone Presbyterian Church was founded in 1798 by farming families who met in a log meetinghouse on this same corner. The stone sanctuary you see today was completed in 1834 using fieldstone cleared from members' land.

Today we are a congregation of about 180 members: lifelong Larkfield families, young couples and newcomers from across Mercer County. We run the town's oldest food pantry and host scouts, recovery groups and community concerts throughout the year.

beliefs.title: God's grace
beliefs.text: We believe we are saved by grace through faith in Jesus Christ, not by our own efforts.

beliefs.title: Scripture
beliefs.text: The Bible is the unique and authoritative witness to Jesus Christ, read in community and guided by the Holy Spirit.

beliefs.title: Sacraments
beliefs.text: We celebrate Baptism and the Lord's Supper as signs of God's love. All baptized Christians are welcome at the Table.

beliefs.title: Service
beliefs.text: Faith is lived out in love for our neighbors, especially those who are hungry, lonely or in need.

staff.name: Rev. Margaret Ellison
staff.bio: Pastor Margaret has served Old Stone since 2014. She loves long walks along the canal, choral music and a good mystery novel.

staff.name: Thomas Reyes
staff.bio: Thomas leads our Chancel Choir and plays the 1912 Möller pipe organ.

staff.name: Linda Park
staff.bio: Linda keeps the office running and is usually the first voice you hear when you call.

ministries.name: Chancel Choir
ministries.description: Singers of all ability levels lead music in Sunday worship.

ministries.name: Larkfield Food Pantry
ministries.description: Serving about 60 families each week since 1983. Volunteers sort, pack and deliver.

ministries.name: Sunday School
ministries.description: Bible stories, crafts and songs for children ages 3 to 11 during the 10 AM service.

ministries.name: Presbyterian Women
ministries.description: Circles for study, prayer and mission projects.

ministries.name: Youth Fellowship
ministries.description: Middle and high schoolers meet for games, faith conversations and service trips.

sermons.note: Sermons are recorded each Sunday and posted the same afternoon.

highlights.title: Harvest Supper
highlights.description: Our annual turkey dinner. Proceeds support the food pantry.

highlights.title: Advent Concert
highlights.description: The Chancel Choir and brass quintet. Free and open to the community.

giving.mailTo: Mail checks payable to Old Stone Presbyterian Church, 12 Church Street, Larkfield, NJ 08000.

visit.intro: We would be delighted to welcome you. Here is what a Sunday morning at Old Stone looks like.

expect.title: Traditional worship
expect.text: Hymns, choir anthems, prayers and Scripture readings, with the order of worship printed in your bulletin.

expect.title: Greeters at the door
expect.text: Ushers will hand you a bulletin and help you find a seat. Large-print bulletins and hymnals are available.

expect.title: Coffee hour
expect.text: Stay after the 10 AM service for coffee and homemade treats in Fellowship Hall.

visit.kids: Children are always welcome in worship. A staffed nursery is available for infants and toddlers, and Sunday school meets during the 10 AM service.
visit.parking: Park in our lot behind the church on Mill Lane, or on Church Street.
visit.accessibility: A ramp and accessible restroom are at the Mill Lane entrance. Hearing assistance devices are available from the ushers.
